newsitem.title: USA: Hawaiian Airlines, Reno Air in pact.
newsitem.headline: Hawaiian Airlines, Reno Air in pact.

text.p: Hawaiian Airlines Tuesday said it formed a code-sharing agreement with Reno Air, effective January 7.
In a statement, the company said the two carriers also plan to link frequent flyer programs.

Under the agreement, Hawaiian Airlines will be able to utilize its two-letter airline computer booking code on 20 Reno Air flights linking Reno, San Jose, Albuquerque, and Tucson with Los Angeles, where the two airlines operations are adjacent, providing direct connections to Hawaiian Airline's three daily flights to Hawaii.
